title: Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Hacken | News | Official Site
text:
Confirmed Chelsea Women line up vs Hacken | News | Official Site | Chelsea Football Club 
 Sonia Bompastor has made six changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Champions League match against Hacken at the Hisingen Arena this evening. 
 After Saturday's 1-1 draw with Everton, the head coach has taken the opportunity to rotate her side. That begins with our goalkeeper, as Hannah Hampton is exchanged for Livia Peng . 
 There are changes in the backline too, with Nathalie Bjorn and Veerle Buurman coming in for Kadeisha Buchanan and Katie McCabe . 
 Lexi Potter returns to the midfield in place of Erin Cuthbert , while Sandy Baltimore and Manaka Matsukubo are named among the substitutes, with Sjoeke Nusken and Alyssa Thompson starting in their place. 
 Melvine Malard leads the line once more, as the striker hopes to add to her tally of two goals scored in Europe this season. 
 Chelsea: Peng, Carpenter, Bronze (c), Bjorn, Buurman, Potter, Walsh, Nusken, Kaptein, Thompson, Malard
 Chelsea substitutes : Hampton, Spencer, Cuthbert, Baltimore, McCabe, Beever-Jones, Matsukubo, Buchanan, Brown, Hamano, Las, Dragoni
